question: In this video, a guitar instructor teaches how to play a classic guitar riff. As part of a broader exploration of guitar history, use external sources to conduct the following research based on a specific article: Find the June 2021 guitar.com article that reports on Total Guitar magazine's 'Greatest Guitar Riffs of All Time' list from its July 2021 issue. First, determine the publication year of that article and calculate the difference in years between that publication year and the release year of the album containing the riff taught in the video. Second, from the same article, identify the top 10 riffs in the list, then determine the release years of the oldest and newest riffs among those top 10, and calculate the difference between those release years. Third, from the article, determine the range of tempos (in BPM) mentioned for the riffs in the list, and calculate the difference between the maximum and minimum BPM values. Finally, sum these three differences to obtain a single numeric answer.
